svg.title: Roofline preset reel
svg.desc: An anonymized geometric house with a long, low silhouette, recessed entry, three plain garage bays and asymmetric, stepped roof tiers. Roof paths are sized to saved LED segment counts; separate eaves are not joined across walls.
svg.text: 621 LEDs / nine segments / every saved effect preset in roof-line.json
Illustrative motion and colors, not a WLED emulator. Reduced motion supported.

g.text: Shimmer + PS Chase + Candle + Color Clouds
